rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for someone argumentative and difficult to reason with.

example.english: They are quarrelsome and refuse to listen, no matter what you say.
example.traditional: 佢個人好拗頸，點講都唔肯聽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 aau3 geng2 dim2 gong2 dou1 m4 hang2 teng1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the person regularly argues with other people.

example.english: They are quarrelsome and argue with people all the time, even during meals.
example.traditional: 佢成日同人拗，連食飯都可以拗餐飽。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tung4 jan4 aau2 lin4 sik6 faan6 dou1 ho2 ji5 aau3 caan1 baau2

rows.jyutping: hou2 zung1 ji3 tung4 jan4 aau2
rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the person enjoys arguing rather than merely being difficult.

example.english: They are quarrelsome and love arguing with people until they win.
example.traditional: 佢好鍾意同人拗，乜嘢都要拗贏。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tung4 jan4 aau2 mat1 je5 dou1 jiu3 aau3 jeng4
